svg.text: PRIME FACTOR STUDIO — IN-BOX USER GUIDE
Kinesthetic Number Theory, Proportional Logarithmic Stacking & 12-Socket Lid Tray

g.text: FEEL THE PRIMES. MULTIPLY WITH HEIGHT.

text.tspan: Standard base-10 counting blocks add lengths (1+1=2).
Prime Factor blocks are logarithmically proportional:
log(a × b) = log(a) + log(b)
Stacking blocks in a tower multiplies their numbers!

g.text: • Unit Datum: Block [2] = 1U = 7.00 mm visible height
• Connector Spec: 1.85mm base plug & stacking socket

text.tspan: Flip 13U lid over to use 12-socket comparison stage.
Equal heights prove equal mathematical products!

g.text: TOTAL: 70 Prime Blocks + Storage Bin + Comparison Stage Lid = 72 Parts
• 4-Color Palette: Neighboring prime columns have distinct hues.
• Instant Sorting: Enables fast visual sorting across 70 blocks.
• Tactile Alignment: Connectors mate smoothly without binding.

text.tspan: Classroom manipulatives get lost. Never abandon
an incomplete set! Every individual math component
is permanently stocked for single replacements.

g.text: Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts

text.tspan: Pack-up is a built-in math game! Each floor
socket is labeled
with its tower's product: 2¹²=4096,
When all 70 blocks are stacked in their
bays, all 12 towers level
at the 84.0mm waterline. Stage lid latches
firmly for quiet carry.
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step
hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage
arrangements, and calculator cross-references!
Keep this card stored inside the box lid!

g.text: Designed in Mountain View, California, USA • Non-Toxic BPA-Free.

text.tspan: Every integer > 1 has a unique prime factorization
decomposition.
